portal_hypertension.title: The Alpha-1 Pi*MZ Genotype Is an Independent Risk Factor for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Development in Patients With ACLD.
portal_hypertension.authors: Balcar L, Semmler G, Scheiner B
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：SERPINA1 Pi*Z 缺乏等位基因的纯合性是 α-1 抗胰蛋白酶缺乏相关肝脏疾病的罪魁祸首，而携带单个 Z 等位基因（例如常见的 Pi*MZ 基因型）是晚期慢性肝病的最强遗传危险因素。 临床提示：SERPINA1 Pi*Z 缺乏等位基因的纯合性是 α-1 抗胰蛋白酶缺乏相关肝脏疾病的罪魁祸首，而携带单个 Z 等位基因（例如常见的 Pi*MZ 基因型）是最强的遗传基因。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Homozygosity for the SERPINA1 Pi*Z deficiency allele is the culprit of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency-related liver disease, while harbouring a single Z-allele (e.g., the common Pi*MZ genotype) is the strongest genetic risk factor for advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD) and its progression. However, the impact of the Pi*MZ genotype on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development in patients who have already progressed to ACLD has yet to be established. Thus, we investigated the impact of the Pi*MZ genotype on the development of HCC among longitudinally followed ACLD patients.
